  - main:
    - link "Spoke Dispatch Help & FAQs":
      - /url: /en/
      - img "Spoke Dispatch Help & FAQs"
    - navigation:
      - link "Go to homepage":
        - /url: https://spoke.com/dispatch
    - text: Search for articles...
    - textbox "Search for articles..."
    - navigation "Breadcrumb":
      - list:
        - listitem:
          - link "All Collections":
            - /url: /en/
        - listitem:
          - 'link "Spoke Help: Dispatch"':
            - /url: https://help.spoke.com/en/collections/1889210-spoke-help-dispatch
        - listitem:
          - link "SPOKE CONNECT, API, SHOPIFY & ZAPIER INTEGRATIONS":
            - /url: https://help.spoke.com/en/collections/3461349-spoke-connect-api-shopify-zapier-integrations
        - listitem: How to use Spoke Connect
    - heading "How to use Spoke Connect" [level=1]
    - paragraph: Provide your clients with access to import their orders and view real-time delivery data
    - text: A Written by Ana Lopatina
    - time: August 4, 2026
    - article:
      - heading "What is Spoke Connect for?" [level=1]
      - paragraph: You can now give your clients access to a private Spoke Connect account. There, they can log in to import their orders directly and see their ETAs, delivery status, and proof of delivery.
      - paragraph
      - paragraph: "We have created Spoke Connect to give you a safe and secure way to provide your clients with:"
      - list:
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: The ability to directly import their orders into your account
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Instantly access real-time information about their deliveries
      - link:
        - /url: https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1175180623/e969071f680406bd508b36e6/icon+logo.png?expires=1793539800&signature=dbe41a34f7178b8b378c39194476355154e4e4290931ce252f03a29591104a77&req=dSEgE8h2nYddWvMW1HO4zZSbIKbNXDRdXpiZAaMLnLOOs8WVJRClp2F1okNO%0An9aGOuHUYgzcSZNWgME%3D%0A
      - paragraph: You
      - paragraph: Invite a client to your Spoke Connect account
      - paragraph: Allow them to import orders
      - paragraph: Assign each client's orders to a depot
      - paragraph: ↓
      - paragraph: 👤 Client
      - paragraph: Logs into the portal
      - paragraph: Their unique Spoke Connect ID number is generated
      - paragraph: They can import their orders ready to be delivered
      - paragraph: ↓
      - link:
        - /url: https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1175180623/e969071f680406bd508b36e6/icon+logo.png?expires=1793539800&signature=dbe41a34f7178b8b378c39194476355154e4e4290931ce252f03a29591104a77&req=dSEgE8h2nYddWvMW1HO4zZSbIKbNXDRdXpiZAaMLnLOOs8WVJRClp2F1okNO%0An9aGOuHUYgzcSZNWgME%3D%0A
      - paragraph: You
      - paragraph: Orders a client has imported will appear in your unsigned stops list
      - paragraph: Add these unassigned stops to a route
      - paragraph: ↓
      - paragraph: 👤 Client
      - paragraph: Can log into their Spoke Connect account to import orders
      - paragraph: Generate and print barcode shipping labels, view delivery ETAs, status, and proof of delivery for all orders
      - separator
      - paragraph
      - heading "How to add clients to Spoke Connect" [level=1]
      - paragraph: "You can invite a client to Spoke Connect in two ways:"
      - paragraph
      - list:
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: On a route or the Stops list, click on a stop to see the stop details
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Under > Order information > Client > Click on > No client
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Click > Add new client
      - paragraph: OR
      - list:
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Go to Controls > External parties > Spoke Connect
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Click > Add new client
          - paragraph
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Invite your client via email or by sharing an invite link
      - paragraph: "If you want the client to have the ability to upload orders to Spoke Connect:"
      - list:
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Toggle on > Allow client to upload orders
      - paragraph: "To make sure that your client uploads the required fields for an order, you can specify which order fields are required:"
      - list:
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Click > Required fields
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: The Address is a mandatory field
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Select which other fields you require your client to upload
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Your client will now only be able to successfully upload a stop to the portal if it has all the required fields
      - paragraph: Orders imported by your clients to Spoke Connect will automatically appear in your unassigned stops list, ready to be added to a route.
      - list:
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Select the default depot that orders from the client should be assigned to
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Your client will now receive an email/link inviting them to > Sign up to Spoke Connect
          - paragraph
      - separator
      - paragraph
      - heading "How your clients can log in to Spoke Connect and add their own team members" [level=1]
      - paragraph:
        - link "Once logged in here":
          - /url: https://connect.spoke.com/login
        - text: ", your client will become the Team Owner and will be able to invite additional members of their team to access their Spoke Connect account. This can be useful if they have multiple team members dealing with the management and delivery of their orders."
      - list:
        - listitem:
          - paragraph:
            - link "Once logged into their Spoke Connect account,":
              - /url: https://connect.spoke.com/login
            - text: your client will become the Team Owner
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: They need to go to Settings > General > Team members
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Click > Add members to invite a new team member
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: New Team members have restricted access and can only see other members and Integrations.
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: To switch the Team Owner role to another person, click > Transfer ownership and follow the instructions
          - paragraph
      - separator
      - paragraph
      - heading "How clients can import orders to Spoke Connect and generate barcode shipping labels" [level=1]
      - paragraph:
        - text: Once you have invited a client to Spoke Connect with the ability to import their orders, clients will be able to
        - link "log in here":
          - /url: https://connect.spoke.com/login
        - text: "and add their orders by:"
      - list:
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Uploading a spreadsheet
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Linking their Shopify store to Spoke Connect
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Adding them manually
      - paragraph:
        - text: You can send your clients a link to
        - link "this handy how-to guide for clients":
          - /url: https://help.getcircuit.com/en/articles/10965997-how-to-use-circuit-s-client-portal
      - paragraph: which walks them through how to access and use Spoke Connect.
      - paragraph: In Spoke Connect, barcode labels are automatically generated using the order details.
      - paragraph
      - paragraph: "Your clients can generate barcode shipping labels by:"
      - list:
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Creating or uploading an order in Connect
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Setting the package count for each order
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Opening an order and clicking > Print shipping labels
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Printing the label and attaching it to the package
      - paragraph: If an order has multiple packages, Spoke will generate a separate barcode label for each package.
      - paragraph
      - paragraph: Your clients can print labels in bulk for multiple orders at once, and all labels work with regular printers or A6-compatible thermal printers.
      - separator
      - paragraph
      - heading "How clients can import orders using a spreadsheet" [level=1]
      - paragraph:
        - link "Send this link to your clients, or click here to download":
          - /url: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/12sAd9Y65cCWreNBexw4QySTxIQgvpG_P8jxm0ik7bp8/edit?gid=0#gid=0
        - text: a copy of our example spreadsheet for clients.
      - paragraph
      - paragraph: "Clients will be able to import the following order data:"
      - list:
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Unit/Flat/Unit Name
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Address Line 1
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Address Line 2
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: City State
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Zip
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Country
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Notes
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Size
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Recipient Name
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Type of stop
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Recipient Email Address
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Recipient Phone Number
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Id
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Package Count
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Products
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Latitude
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Longitude
      - paragraph:
        - link "Click here":
          - /url: https://help.getcircuit.com/en/articles/3582870-how-to-prepare-your-spreadsheet-for-import#:~:text=Spreadsheet%20Glossary
        - text: to see the spreadsheet data glossary.
      - paragraph
      - heading "Importing orders" [level=1]
      - paragraph: "When a client has their order data formatted in a spreadsheet and is ready to import it clients need to:"
      - list:
        - listitem:
          - paragraph:
            - link "Log in to Spoke Connect":
              - /url: https://connect.spoke.com/login
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Click > Import orders from spreadsheet
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Select the spreadsheet they want to upload
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Follow the import process on the screen
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Clients will see the message > Draft orders successfully imported
          - paragraph
      - separator
      - paragraph
      - heading "How clients can import orders from their Shopify store" [level=1]
      - paragraph: If your client wants to import orders from their Shopify store into Spoke Connect, they must be an Admin/Owner role and first need to link their Shopify store with Connect.
      - paragraph
      - heading "How to link a Shopify store with Connect" [level=1]
      - list:
        - listitem:
          - paragraph:
            - link "Log in to Spoke Connect":
              - /url: https://connect.spoke.com/login
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Go to Settings > General > Integrations
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Go to Shopify and click > Connect store
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: They will then land on the Connect Shopify listing, click > Install
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Accept access permissions and click > Install
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: They will then be redirected back to Spoke Connect
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Their Shopify store is now linked with Spoke Connect
      - heading "How to turn on automatic Shopify updates" [level=1]
      - paragraph: "To have completed Connect deliveries automatically update their status to fulfilled in Shopify, and recipients automatically receive a notification from Shopify when a Connect delivery has been completed, your client will need to enable these settings:"
      - list:
        - listitem:
          - paragraph:
            - link "Log in to Spoke Connect":
              - /url: https://connect.spoke.com/login
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Go to Settings > General > Intergrations
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Toggle on the setting > Automatically mark orders as fulfilled in Shopify
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Toggle on the setting > Notify customer via Shopify when fulfilled
      - heading "How to import orders from Shopify" [level=1]
      - paragraph: "With their Shopify store linked to Connect, your client can import their orders, they will need to:"
      - list:
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Go to Orders, click > Add or import orders, select > Import from Shopify
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: All their Shopify orders will be imported onto a list in Spoke Connect
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: They can select individual orders that they want to import
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: They can also click > Bulk import and add all the order IDs they want to import in the text box, then click > Import orders
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Those orders have now been imported into Spoke Connect as draft orders and are ready to be submitted for delivery
          - paragraph
      - separator
      - paragraph
      - heading "Submitting orders for delivery" [level=1]
      - paragraph: With all their orders imported as a draft, clients can now select which of those orders they want to submit for delivery.
      - paragraph
      - paragraph: "To submit orders for delivery, clients need to:"
      - list:
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Select the draft orders they wish to submit for delivery from the list
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Click > Submit for delivery
      - paragraph: Once an order has been submitted, it cannot be edited, but it can be withdrawn as long as it hasn't been assigned to a route.
      - list:
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Clients can check the status of submitted deliveries under > Active orders
      - paragraph
      - heading "Order status updates" [level=1]
      - paragraph: "The status of orders goes from:"
      - list:
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Draft > Submitted - when an order has been submitted for delivery
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Submitted > Scheduled - when an order has been added to a route
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Scheduled > ETA - when the driver starts the route
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: ETA > real-time status update - as the deliveries are completed
      - paragraph
      - separator
      - paragraph
      - heading "How to sync client data to Spoke Connect if you do not allow clients to upload orders" [level=1]
      - paragraph: In some cases, you may not want to give clients the ability to upload their orders directly to Spoke Connect.
      - paragraph
      - paragraph: You can provide them with just the basic ability to use the portal to track the live status of their deliveries.
      - list:
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Once a client has signed up to Spoke Connect they will be given a unique Client ID number
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Now when importing stops for this client you will need to add their unique Client ID number to your data import
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Adding this unique Client ID number syncs key delivery data between the dispatcher dashboard and the Spoke Connect view
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Your client will now be able to log into the portal to see ETAs, delivery status updates, and access proof of delivery in real-time
          - paragraph
      - separator
      - paragraph
      - heading "What clients invited to Spoke Connect will see" [level=1]
      - paragraph: In your Spoke Dispatch account, you will be able to see every client that you have invited.
      - paragraph
      - paragraph: Each individual client that you invite will only be able to see details of their own deliveries when they log in.
      - paragraph
      - separator
      - paragraph
      - heading "Got a question?" [level=1]
      - paragraph:
        - text: Contact your account manager, start a live chat, or email
        - link "support@spoke.com":
          - /url: mailto:support@spoke.com
    - group "Did this answer your question?":
      - text: Did this answer your question?
      - button "Did this answer your question? Disappointed Reaction": Disappointed Reaction
      - button "Did this answer your question? Neutral Reaction": Neutral Reaction
      - button "Did this answer your question? Smiley Reaction": Smiley Reaction
    - link "What is Spoke Connect for?":
      - /url: "#h_0b8ab68bd2"
    - link "How to add clients to Spoke Connect":
      - /url: "#h_d2b5242c71"
    - link "How your clients can log in to Spoke Connect and add their own team members":
      - /url: "#h_c908a957e6"
    - link "How clients can import orders to Spoke Connect and generate barcode shipping labels":
      - /url: "#h_c03b1bf922"
    - link "How clients can import orders using a spreadsheet":
      - /url: "#h_1a7fecce30"
    - link "Importing orders":
      - /url: "#h_105d261753"
    - link "How clients can import orders from their Shopify store":
      - /url: "#h_13c42bd0d5"
    - link "How to link a Shopify store with Connect":
      - /url: "#h_012f6828bc"
    - link "How to turn on automatic Shopify updates":
      - /url: "#h_102f98d226"
    - link "How to import orders from Shopify":
      - /url: "#h_1e0c236078"
    - link "Submitting orders for delivery":
      - /url: "#h_0178abad4c"
    - link "Order status updates":
      - /url: "#h_b213408bb7"
    - link "How to sync client data to Spoke Connect if you do not allow clients to upload orders":
      - /url: "#h_8123b5ab49"
    - link "What clients invited to Spoke Connect will see":

- document:
  - banner:
    - link "DoorDash for Dashers":
      - /url: /en-us
    - navigation "Primary Navigation":
      - list:
        - listitem:
          - link "Earn":
            - /url: /en-us
        - listitem:
          - link "Dash":
            - /url: /en-us

            - /url: /en-us
        - listitem:
          - link "Support":
            - /url: /en-us
    - button "Search"
    - button "US"
    - button "Sign Up"
  - main:
    - heading "Your Door to Reliable Paydays" [level=1]
    - paragraph: Learn more about how Dasher pay works, along with tools to help you track and increase your earnings to meet your goals.
    - heading "Sign up to become a Dasher" [level=2]
    - combobox "Country":
      - option "+1 (US)" [selected]
      - option "+1 (CA)"
      - option "+61 (AU)"
      - option "+64 (NZ)"
    - textbox "Phone Number"
    - textbox "Email Address"
    - checkbox "Get updates on offers and news via text. Consent isn't required to sign up. Reply STOP to cancel, HELP for help. Msg & data rates may apply."
    - text: Get updates on offers and news via text. Consent isn't required to sign up. Reply STOP to cancel, HELP for help. Msg & data rates may apply.
    - paragraph:
      - text: By clicking "Continue," I agree to the
      - link "Independent Contractor Agreement":
        - /url: https://help.doordash.com/legal/document?type=dx-ica&region=us&locale=en_US
      - text: and have read the
      - link "Dasher Privacy Policy":
        - /url: https://help.doordash.com/legal/document?type=dx-privacy-policy&region=us&locale=en_US
      - text: .
    - button "Continue"
    - img "Dx - Dasher - Flowers - Delivery"
    - heading "How does Dasher" [level=2]
    - heading "pay work?" [level=2]
    - paragraph: "We know that Dashers have a lot of choices when it comes to gig work. This is why DoorDash has created a pay model designed to make delivery driver earnings fair and transparent. Dasher pay has three components:"
    - button "Base Pay" [expanded]
    - region "Base Pay":
      - paragraph: Base pay is DoorDash's base contribution for each offer. When Dashers choose to earn per offer, base pay is based on the estimated time, distance, and desirability of the offer. When earning by time, base pay is based on the minimum guaranteed active hourly rate for the time spent actively on a delivery. Base pay will not change based on the customer tip amount.
    - button "Promotions"
    - button "Tips"
    - img "A woman working as a Dasher."
    - heading "Ways to earn as a" [level=2]
    - heading "Doordash driver" [level=2]
    - paragraph: "When you dash, you can choose between two different earning modes: Earn per Offer and Earn by Time."
    - heading "Earn per Offer" [level=2]
    - paragraph
    - paragraph: With Earn per Offer, you earn for each offer completed while dashing. The amount per offer will change depending on the offer's time, distance, and desirability. You'll always see the guaranteed minimum pay for the offer before you accept .
    - heading "Earn by Time" [level=2]
    - paragraph
    - paragraph:
      - text: With
      - link "Earn by Time":
        - /url: /en-us/blog/earn-by-time-mode-explained
      - text: ", you earn a minimum guaranteed active hourly rate while on a delivery. The hourly rate is based on your active time, which is the time you are engaged in completing an order, starting from the moment an offer is accepted until it is completed. Tips and applicable promotions are added on top."
    - paragraph
    - heading "Delivery Driver" [level=2]
    - heading "Promotions" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Promotions and incentives are additional pay for offers that meet certain conditions, allowing Dashers to earn even more. They can vary between Dashers based on factors like location and time of day.
    - tablist:
      - tab "Peak Pay" [selected]
      - tab "Challenges"
      - tab "Boosts"
    - tabpanel "Peak Pay":
      - img "Dx - Delivery Driver Promotions - Peak Pay"
      - heading "Peak Pay" [level=3]
      - text: When Peak Pay is in effect, select Dashers can earn extra money on each offer. In Earn per Offer mode, Peak Pay adds an amount per eligible, completed delivery. In Earn by Time mode, Peak Pay adds an amount to the guaranteed active hourly rate. Peak Pay is applied automatically;be sure to check the Promos tab in the Dasher app to see if Peak Pay is in effect.
    - heading "How Dashers get paid" [level=2]
    - img
    - heading "WEEKLY" [level=3]
    - paragraph: You automatically get paid weekly by direct deposit to your bank account. Payments are transferred directly and usually take 2–3 days to show up.
    - img
    - heading "DAILY" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Dashers can select Fast Pay to get earnings once per day for a small fee of $1.99.* Fast Pay is subject to eligibility and approval. You must have a debit card (not a prepaid card) to use the Fast Pay service.
    - img
    - heading "INSTANTLY" [level=3]
    - paragraph:
      - text: With
      - link "DoorDash Crimson":
        - /url: /en-us/doordashcrimson
      - text: ", get instant deposits.**"
    - paragraph: "*Fast Pay is subject to eligibility, approval, and a $1.99 fee per transaction. **Earnings deposits typically occur within seconds. There may be times when deposits are delayed or not completed."
    - img "dx_makethemost_walk"
    - heading "Track Your Weekly Progress" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Every Dasher has a number they're working toward. Now the app helps you get there.
    - paragraph:
      - text: The weekly
      - link "Earnings Goal Tracker":
        - /url: /en-us/blog/earnings-goal-tracker
      - text: "lets you:"
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - paragraph: Set a personalized weekly earnings target
      - listitem:
        - paragraph: Track your progress in real time as you dash
      - listitem:
        - paragraph: Celebrate milestones along the way
    - paragraph: "Your goal is based on your actual dashing history: your market, your typical hours, what you've earned before. You're always in control. Adjust your goal up or down or skip it entirely. Whatever fits your week."
    - heading "How the earnings" [level=2]
    - heading "goal tracker works" [level=2]
    - img
    - heading "SET YOUR GOAL" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Head to the Earnings tab in the Dasher app. You'll see a goal setup flow with suggested weekly targets — Light, Recommended, and Ambitious — each showing how many hours it typically takes to get there. Use the slider to pick what fits. Not sure? Start with Recommended. You can change it anytime.
    - img
    - heading "TRACK YOUR PROGRESS WHILE YOU DASH" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Once your goal is set, you'll see a progress bar right in the Earnings tab and on your dash screen. No more guessing. No more manually adding up your earnings throughout the week. The app shows you exactly where you stand.
    - paragraph
    - img
    - heading "CELEBRATE THE WIN" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Hit your goal? You'll see it. The Dasher app acknowledges the milestone. Didn't quite make it this week? You'll get a prompt to adjust for next week. Goals reset automatically every Monday morning.
    - blockquote:
      - paragraph: "\"I like seeing my progress — it's motivating. It helps me stay out just a bit longer to hit my goal.\""
      - text: — Dasher feedback from the weekly goal tracker pilot
    - paragraph: Currently rolling out to Platinum Dashers. Open the Dasher app → Earnings tab → Set your goal.
    - img "Dx - Dasher - Supermarket"
    - img "Dx - Dasher - DoorDash Crimson"
    - text: DOORDASH CRIMSON
    - heading "GET PAID THE MOMENT YOU FINISH A DASH" [level=2]
    - paragraph:
      - link "DoorDash Crimson":
        - /url: /en-us/doordashcrimson
      - text: "** is a personal banking account where Dashers can receive their earnings instantly, enjoy cash back and perks, and manage their money easily and securely, all within the Dasher app. No credit check required. No monthly fees."
    - paragraph: "Here's what you get:"
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - paragraph: "Instant Pay after every dash: Earnings deposited automatically, no fee."
      - listitem:
        - paragraph: "Early direct deposit: Set up direct deposit from any employer and get paid up to two days early."
      - listitem:
        - paragraph: Your own account and routing number to manage all your income in one place.
      - listitem:
        - paragraph: Access to 40,000+ MoneyPass ATMs nationwide.
      - listitem:
        - paragraph: No monthly fee. No credit check. Apply in the Earnings tab of your Dasher app.
      - listitem:
        - paragraph: With Savings jar, you can automatically set earnings aside for bills, unexpected repairs, or future goals.
    - paragraph: "**The DoorDash Crimson Deposit Account is established by Starion Bank, Member FDIC. The DoorDash Crimson Visa Debit Card is issued by Starion Bank pursuant to a license from Visa U.S.A. Inc. Certain fees, terms, and conditions are associated with the approval, maintenance, and use of the Deposit Account and Card."
    - region "Feature gallery carousel":
      - heading "Tips to maximize your earnings" [level=2]
      - group "Card 1 of 6:":
        - paragraph: Track your expenses
        - paragraph: As an independent contractor in the gig economy, you may be eligible for tax deductions on mileage, phone use, and vehicle maintenance. Keep records throughout the year. Your Earnings History in the app is a useful reference at tax time.
      - group "Card 2 of 6:":
        - paragraph: Keep your Dasher rating high
        - paragraph: Platinum Dashers get priority access to high-paying orders. On-time delivery and order accuracy are some of the biggest factors in your ratings.
      - group "Card 3 of 6:":
        - paragraph: Set a weekly goal
        - paragraph: Need some personal accountability or help keeping track of how you’re doing? Dashers who use the Earnings Goal Tracker report feeling more motivated and are more intentional about where and when they dash. Set yours in the Earnings tab.
      - group "Card 4 of 6:":
        - paragraph: Dash during peak hours
        - paragraph: Lunch and dinner tend to be the busiest times of day. Check the Promos tab before you start a dash to see if Peak Pay is active in your zone.
      - group "Card 5 of 6:":
        - paragraph: Use Hotspots
        - paragraph: Open your map and look for the red zones — those are Hotspots, areas with higher order demand. Positioning yourself near a Hotspot reduces idle time between offers.
      - group "Card 6 of 6:":
        - paragraph: Try Earn by Time during busy periods
        - paragraph: When orders are quiet, Earn by Time can give you a more predictable earnings floor — so slow stretches don't feel like a wash. You still keep 100% of tips and applicable promotions. Check your app for the current rate before starting your dash.
    - heading "Ready to start dashing?" [level=2]
    - paragraph:
      - text: DoorDash is one of the most flexible ways to earn in the gig economy. Sign up at dasher.doordash.com. You'll need to be 18 or older*, have a valid driver's license, pass a background check, and have access to a vehicle. The sign-up process takes just a few minutes. * Minimum age to dash varies by state and may be higher than 18. Check the
      - link "Requirements":
        - /url: https://dasher.doordash.com/en-us/requirements
      - text: page for more details.
    - link "Sign up to Dash →":
      - /url: https://www.doordash.com/dasher/app/
    - img "Dx - Ways to Dash - Shop & Deliver - Hero - Dasher shopping at grocery store for pet food"

    - button "Base Pay" [expanded]

      - paragraph: Base pay is DoorDash's base contribution for each offer. When Dashers choose to earn per offer, base pay is based on the estimated time, distance, and desirability of the offer. When earning by time, base pay is based on the minimum guaranteed active hourly rate for the time spent actively on a delivery. Base pay will not change based on the customer tip amount.
    - button "Promotions"

    - paragraph: "Your goal is based on your actual dashing history: your market, your typical hours, what you've earned before. You're always in control. Adjust your goal up or down or skip it entirely. Whatever fits your week."

        - paragraph: Track your expenses
        - paragraph: As an independent contractor in the gig economy, you may be eligible for tax deductions on mileage, phone use, and vehicle maintenance. Keep records throughout the year. Your Earnings History in the app is a useful reference at tax time.

        - paragraph: Need some personal accountability or help keeping track of how you’re doing? Dashers who use the Earnings Goal Tracker report feeling more motivated and are more intentional about where and when they dash. Set yours in the Earnings tab.

        - paragraph: Lunch and dinner tend to be the busiest times of day. Check the Promos tab before you start a dash to see if Peak Pay is active in your zone.

        - listitem: Overall Dasher Rating
    - article:
      - heading "Overall Dasher Rating" [level=1]
      - img
      - text: 11 min read
      - paragraph:
        - strong: Overview
      - paragraph: The Overall Dasher Rating is a new way to qualify for Dasher Rewards, giving you more flexibility to unlock higher earnings and exciting new perks. Features and eligibility may vary by Dasher. Check the Ratings tab in your app to see what applies to you. Please note that Dashers must have completed 50 or more deliveries to be eligible for the Rewards program.
      - paragraph:
        - strong: Dasher Rewards may vary by location
        - text: "Program details and eligibility may differ in select markets such as: New York City, California, Seattle, international markets, and other areas. The following information refers to the Rewards program available in most areas in the United States, but check your Dasher app for the most accurate information about the program available to you."
      - list:
        - listitem:
          - paragraph:
            - link "New York City program details":
              - /url: /en-us/dashers/article/dasher-rewards-program-nyc
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: "All other locations: Check your Dasher app for details"
      - paragraph:
        - strong: What is the Overall Dasher Rating?
      - paragraph: "The Overall Dasher Rating (ODR) combines points from six factors:"
      - list:
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Acceptance rate
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Completion rate
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Customer rating
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: On-time rate
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Quality rate
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Last 30-day orders
      - paragraph: Your total score determines your Rewards status — Silver, Gold, or Platinum. Your Overall Dasher rating will adjust based on individual rating changes
      - paragraph:
        - strong: What does this mean for you?
      - paragraph: You’ll qualify for a rewards status based on your Overall Dasher Rating. This means there are more ways to qualify for Rewards when you deliver with high-quality service.
      - list:
        - listitem:
          - paragraph:
            - strong: "More flexibility:"
            - text: Reach higher statuses in multiple ways.
        - listitem:
          - paragraph:
            - strong: "More earnings:"
            - text: Earn more and wait less with priority access to high-paying orders and Offer Boosts.
        - listitem:
          - paragraph:
            - strong: "More perks:"
            - text: Unlock new benefits like Store Pause and Platinum Pass.
      - paragraph: You can view your score, ratings, and points breakdown in the Ratings tab of the Dasher app.
      - paragraph:
        - strong: Overall Dasher Rating FAQ
      - paragraph:
        - text: "Q:"
        - strong: How is the Overall Dasher Rating calculated?
      - paragraph: "A: Your current acceptance rate, completion rate, customer rating, on-time rate, quality rate, and last 30-day orders will help you earn points towards the Overall Dasher Rating. Any change in these ratings will subsequently update your Overall Dasher Rating"
      - paragraph:
        - text: "Q:"
        - strong: How soon will I receive rewards after qualifying for a new status?
      - paragraph: "A: Once your Overall Dasher Rating qualifies you for a new status, your new eligible rewards will be unlocked instantly and will remain active as long as your Overall Dasher Rating stays within the requirements for that status."
      - paragraph:
        - text: "Q:"
        - strong: What happens if my Overall Dasher Rating drops below the minimum to qualify?
      - paragraph: "A: If your Overall Dasher Rating drops below the minimum to qualify for rewards, you will still be able to dash but will no longer qualify for the rewards in the Dasher Rewards program. You can always check the Ratings tab in the Dasher app to see how many points you’re getting for each of your ratings and identify areas to increase your points."
      - paragraph:
        - text: "Q:"
        - strong: What if I have completed less than 50 deliveries?
      - paragraph: "A: We understand that it takes time to learn how to use the platform. To help you get off to a great start, new Dashers will have access to special perks on your first 50 deliveries, regardless of what your Overall Dasher Rating is. After you’ve completed your first 50 deliveries, you’ll then be eligible to qualify for the Dasher Rewards program based on your Overall Dasher Rating."
      - paragraph:
        - text: "Q:"
        - strong: How can I check my ratings and level?
        - text: "A: You can look at your Ratings tab in the Dasher app to see your current status and unlocked rewards."
      - img "ODR - US"
      - paragraph:
        - text: "Q:"
        - strong: Can I still decline offers?
      - paragraph: "A: Dashers can accept or decline offers based on their personal preferences."
      - paragraph:
        - text: "Q:"
        - strong: What happens to my Overall Dasher Rating if I dash outside of my area?
      - paragraph: "A: The Overall Dasher Rating will determine your eligibility for the Rewards program if you’re in an eligible area. If you dash frequently in multiple areas, your Rewards qualification may revert to the qualification criteria in another area. Check the Ratings tab in your app any time to stay updated."
      - paragraph:
        - text: "Q:"
        - strong: Are there any other terms or conditions that I should know about?
        - text: "A: We may modify or end this program at any time for any reason, and eligibility is not guaranteed. We reserve the right to delay payment for purposes of investigation and to withhold payment or close the account(s) of any Dasher if we determine in our sole discretion that a Dasher has used or attempted to use this program in a fraudulent, abusive, or otherwise suspicious manner or violation of any applicable law or regulation"
      - heading "Rewards FAQ" [level=2]:
        - strong: Rewards FAQ
      - paragraph:
        - strong: "Q: What rewards do I get from being a part of the program? A:"
        - text: Depending on your current level and area, the rewards that we are offering are
      - list:
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Priority Access to high-paying orders
          - list:
            - listitem:
              - paragraph: This perk gives qualifying Dashers priority for high paying orders. Dashers who have unlocked this perk will get priority access, which increases the likelihood of seeing a high paying order. Dashers will get even higher priority as their rewards status increases across Silver, Gold and Platinum.
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Priority access to Dash Now
          - list:
            - listitem:
              - paragraph: Dashers with this reward will have priority access when Dash Now is available. In some eligible areas of Overall Dasher Rating, all Dashers will be able to “Dash Now” regardless of whether or not it is busy.
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Offer Boosts
          - list:
            - listitem:
              - paragraph: Platinum Dashers will get priority on all offers and on average can expect the shortest wait times, followed by Gold, then Silver, and then Dashers who haven’t earned Reward status yet.*
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: VIP Dasher Support
          - list:
            - listitem:
              - paragraph:
                - text: When available, Dashers who reach out to Support will be routed to top agents who are equipped to handle all types of Dasher issues
                - emphasis: "* Based on average offer frequency compared to Gold, Silver, and Dashers without Reward status. Actual offer wait times may vary based on various factors, such as time of day, location, and offer availability."
      - paragraph:
        - text: "Q:"
        - strong: What are “high-paying orders”?
        - text: "A: High paying orders are some of the highest paying deliveries in the area, which can vary by area, over time, and by delivery distance. We calculate high paying orders based on total pay, which includes base pay, peak pay, and tips."
      - paragraph: Look out for your rewards tier icon in the Dasher app when you receive an offer, which means that you were prioritized for this high paying order.
      - img "ODR -US high pay orders"
      - paragraph:
        - text: "Q:"
        - strong: "I am at Platinum level in my area and see that I have the reward: “Discounts on DoorDash” - How does this work?"
        - text: "A:"
        - strong
        - text: "Only Dashers with Platinum level on Mondays at 10am PST in select markets will be eligible to receive the reward every 2 weeks. This promotion will be live starting on Mondays through the following Sunday 23:59PM local times for eligible Dashers in select markets, and is limited to one redemption per user. Dashers must use their Dasher app login (email/password) to sign into the DoorDash app and, if eligible, the discount will be available in the DoorDash app under ‘Promo Codes’ at checkout. Limit one redemption per person, available on Monday every 2 weeks. Q:"
        - strong: Will Dash Now always guarantee fast offers?
      - paragraph: "A: Not necessarily. Dash Now gives the ability to start a dash anytime, but the offer frequency depends on demand, time of day, and local offer volume. Offer Boosts give priority to higher status but do not guarantee offers."
      - paragraph:
        - text: "Q:"
        - strong: If everyone can Dash Now, won’t that increase competition for offers?
      - paragraph: "A: It can — but Offer Boosts mean higher-status Dashers still get priority, so they spend less time waiting."
      - paragraph:
        - text: "Q:"
        - strong: Can I still schedule dashes if I prefer to plan ahead?
      - paragraph:
        - text: "A: Yes. The Schedule tab remains available for those who prefer to plan ahead but it now shows suggested busy time slots to choose from instead of all available slots. As a reminder, it’s no longer necessary to schedule ahead in order to guarantee a spot for a certain timeslot — all Dashers with the new"
        - strong: Overall Dasher Rating
        - text: can now go online anytime.
      - paragraph:
        - strong: Store Pause
      - paragraph: Select Gold and Platinum Dashers are eligible for a reward called — Store Pause — which allows you to stop receiving offers from certain nearby stores for two weeks. Check the Ratings tab in your Dasher app to see if this reward appears for you.
      - paragraph: This reward gives you more control and flexibility over the kinds of offers you receive — so you can earn the way you want.
      - paragraph:
        - strong: How it works
      - list:
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Gold Dashers can pause offers from 1 store for 2 weeks.
        - listitem:
          - paragraph: Platinum Dashers can pause offers from up to 3 stores for 2 weeks each.
      - paragraph: The pause applies to offers from selected stores only and may take up to 5 minutes to take effect.
      - paragraph: After the two-week period ends, offers from that store will resume automatically, and you’ll receive a notification in the app.
      - paragraph:
        - text: "Q:"
        - strong: How do I pause offers from a store?
      - paragraph: "A: When you receive an order from a store you’d like to pause, start by declining the offer. After declining, and if the option is available for that store, you’ll see a toggle to pause offers from that location. Turn the toggle on and press decline again to activate the pause."
      - paragraph: Once activated, you won’t receive offers from that store for two weeks. Under your Dasher Rewards, you’ll see a list of paused stores, including their names and addresses, and when each pause period will end.
      - paragraph:
        - text: "Q:"
        - strong: Can I pause any store?
      - paragraph: "A: No. The option to pause may not appear for every store or every time you receive an offer. Only eligible stores in your area will show the pause toggle after declining an order."
      - paragraph:
        - text: "Q:"
        - strong: Can I turn off a pause early?
      - paragraph: "A: Yes. You can pause offers from your Ratings tab at any time. However, once you do, you won’t be able to pause offers from another store until the original two-week period has fully passed."
      - paragraph:
        - text: "Q:"
        - strong: Why don’t I see the option to pause after declining an order?
      - paragraph: "A: Store Pause may only be available in select locations and for certain stores. If you don’t see the toggle, the option may not be available at that time or for that store."
      - paragraph:
        - strong: Platinum Pass
      - paragraph: Select Dashers may be eligible for a perk called — Platinum Pass — which allows you to earn and redeem a week of Platinum status. Check the Ratings tab to see if this reward appears for you. You can refer to the Platinum Pass section of the Ratings tab to track progress, unlock, and redeem your passes.
      - paragraph:
        - strong: How it works
      - paragraph: For every 200 consecutive deliveries completed while maintaining Platinum status, you’ll earn one Platinum Pass that you can redeem for a week of Platinum. When redeemed, that Platinum Pass automatically grants Platinum-level benefits like top priority to high-paying offers, VIP support, and discounts in your area for 7 days, even if your current ratings drop below Platinum thresholds. Unless otherwise provided in the app, Platinum Passes expire after 1 year.
      - paragraph:
        - emphasis: "*Platinum Pass is non-transferable, has no cash value, and may be modified or revoked in DoorDash’s sole discretion."
      - paragraph:
        - text: "Q:"
        - strong: How do I unlock Platinum Pass?
      - paragraph: "A: You need to complete at least one delivery to be eligible. Complete 200 consecutive deliveries while holding Platinum status to unlock Platinum Pass. Only deliveries completed while you are Platinum status count toward your progress. If you drop below the Platinum status before reaching 200, your progress resets."
      - paragraph:
        - text: "Q:"
        - strong: I was close to earning a Platinum week under the previous reward system. Do those weeks or deliveries carry over?
      - paragraph: "A: We know this is a change from the previous Platinum Pass reward. With the new 200-delivery Platinum Pass reward, progress from the previous 28-day system doesn’t carry over. All Dashers begin at 0 deliveries when the new reward is released in your area, and only deliveries completed while in Platinum count."
      - paragraph:
        - text: "Q:"
        - strong: How do I redeem it?
      - paragraph: "A: Go to the Ratings tab and select “Platinum Pass”. The Platinum Pass reward can only be redeemed when your current ratings qualify you for Silver or Gold."
      - paragraph: Tap Redeem to activate a reward week of Platinum. You can only redeem one week at a time. Once redeemed, you can track your progress and find the expiration time for your Platinum Pass(es) under the “Your unlocked rewards” section in the app.
      - paragraph:
        - text: "Q:"
        - strong: What happens after my Platinum Pass expires?
      - paragraph: "A: Your current Overall Dasher Rating will set your Rewards status. So if you still meet Platinum qualifications, you’ll stay at Platinum."
      - paragraph:
        - text: "Q:"
        - strong: Does progress carry over if I dash in multiple areas?
      - paragraph: "A: Yes — as long as you maintain Platinum while completing deliveries. Some Platinum perks may vary by location due to local regulations."
      - paragraph:
        - strong: Disclaimer
        - text: ": DoorDash may modify the qualification terms, rewards offered, and available markets at any time."
      - paragraph: The Dasher Rewards Program is currently being offered with certain rewards and features available in certain locations (which may differ by area). You understand that DoorDash may terminate or modify the Program (including, without limitation, what the Rewards are, how you earn them, and the duration and availability of the program) at any time in DoorDash’s sole discretion. DoorDash further reserves the right to offer select rewards and/or make modifications to the Program only to limited cohorts of participants at its sole discretion. Check the Dasher App to determine if the program is available in your market and if you are eligible to participate.
      - paragraph: DoorDash also reserves the right to modify or remove a Dasher’s reward status, delay payment for purposes of investigation, and to withhold payment or close the account(s) of any Dasher if we determine in our sole discretion that a Dasher has used or attempted to use the Dasher Rewards Program or Dasher app in a fraudulent, abusive, or otherwise suspicious manner, or has violated the Independent Contractor Agreement, the Platform Access Policy, or any applicable law or regulation.
